EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN
  SELECT c01, c02, c03
    FROM t1, x01, x02, x03
   WHERE a01=b01 AND a02=b02 AND a03=b03;

  SELECT c01, c02, c03, c04
    FROM t1, x01, x02, x03, x04
   WHERE a01=b01 AND a02=b02 AND a03=b03 AND a04=b04;

   WHERE a01=b01 AND a02=b02 AND a03=b03 AND a04=b04 AND a05=b05
